readout_other: Tinnitus Functional Index (TFI); Tinnitus Loudness Visual Analog Scale (VAS); James' Blinding Index; adverse effects questionnaire (adapted from tDCS studies)
direction_notes: The study was not designed or powered to measure a treatment effect on tinnitus loudness; most participants' tinnitus loudness decreased or stayed the same in both the active and sham conditions, with similar patterns across both.
safety_notes: Adverse effects were uncommon and mostly mild, primarily sensations on the skin beneath the transducer (itching, burning, pain, tingling, warmth/heat, redness); one moderate 'warmth/heat' event occurred in the active condition; no serious adverse events were reported.

exposures.label: Active U-VNS via ZenBud device to the auricular branch of the vagus nerve

target.label: auricular branch of the vagus nerve

timing.protocol_description: The device turns off automatically after 29 min, and is designed to imitate a standard headset. Participants underwent either active U-VNS or sham stimulation using the ZenBud device, which lasted for approximately 29 min, during which time they sat in a quiet room with the investigator.

source_quotes.n_subjects: In this singleblind randomized controlled study, 20 volunteers with chronic tinnitus received two 29 min sessions of true U-VNS followed by sham U-VNS, or vice versa.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Ten participants experienced the sham condition in the first appointment and then active stimulation in the second, and the other ten received active U-VNS first followed by sham stimulation in the second session.
source_quotes.randomised: the order in which these conditions took place was randomly assigned based on a random sequence, electronically generated by a research assistant who had no further involvement in the study.
source_quotes.blinding: In this singleblind randomized controlled study, 20 volunteers with chronic tinnitus received two 29 min sessions of true U-VNS followed by sham U-VNS, or vice versa.

flags.reason: Paper calls this value an 'average intensity' but reports it in MPa (a pressure unit) rather than W/cm²; recorded as pressure since the unit is a pressure unit. Domain (free field vs in situ) is not stated.
PRF (41 Hz) and duty cycle (50%) are stated but no pulse duration is given in the text, so pulse duration is left not_reported rather than computed.
Only participants were blinded; investigator blinding was not possible because the active and sham transducers sat on different ears.
